# Hartem Yaakoub

> Algerian engineer & founder of TKAWEN — an academic spin-off enterprise under arrêté MESRS n° 1275 and décret exécutif 20-254, matricule UBMA-STARTUP-2023-00062. Has shipped 11 production digital platforms. Selected for ASEP Cohort 3 (Algerian Startup Expedition Program), South Korea, October 2024.
